en: "And Council Chair Wattner happened to see it...{w}Until just the other day, I was demoted to the provinces.{w}
note: Mayleen continues row 1279: she yelled at a rude adventurer and Wattner saw it. 'Left-sen' = demoted/sent off to a provincial post.
Chuuou = the central government/capital; rendered 'the capital'. Nested quote from Wattner set in single quotes.
Interi ('intellectual') was evidently the rude adventurer's jibe; rendered 'egghead' so it reads as an insult she insists is a compliment.

en: "You're right,{w}not everyone is the same, are they?"{w}
note: Reply to an unseen player choice/remark (likely that not all adventurers are like that one).

en: "Thank you so very much.{w}With this, I can take far more accurate measurements.{w}If you ever want to know the weather, just say so."{w}
"Oh, but I will be charging a fee for use of the facility.{w}I never mix business with personal matters."{w}
{0E}  * You can now control the weather *{0F}{w}
note: System notice; format follows the existing '* ... now in stock *' line.

en: "I have every confidence in my research.{w}Whenever you want to know the weather, ask me any time.{w}
"Ah... and one more thing: watch out for storms.{w}Tornadoes only occur in certain places, but{w}

"What is it?
This has nothing to do with adventurers."{w}

"It's still being prepared."{w}{p}"I expect it will be finished
by the time you're back from Teridon."{w}
note: Teridon = TERIDON (town TRD); new name.

en: {0E}  * The weather is now {0C:0001:0001} *{0F}{w}
note: Insert shows one of rows 1294-1297, so those are adjectives (Clear/Cloudy/Rainy/Stormy) to read 'The weather is now Rainy'.

en: Clear
note: Weather name, also inserted into row 1293.

en: Cloudy
Rainy
note: Source has a trailing full-width pad space; dropped.

en: Stormy
note: Source has a trailing full-width pad space; dropped.

en: "Oh? Haven't seen your mugs around before.{w}First time in this town? Yeah? Great!{w}Well, ain't that convenient..."{w}
note: Speaker shown as ???? (Zonette before introduction).

en: Zonette
"Whoops, I'm Zonette!{w}Nice. Ta. Meet. Ya!"{w}{p}"Okay, let's get right to it! I need a favor.{w}See, the thing is..."{w}
note: Yo-ro-shi-ku spelled out syllable by syllable; rendered with full stops between words.

en: Molder
"What are you doing, Zonette?"{w}
"Ugh, Molder."{w}
"You're not{w}up to some scheme again, are you?"{w}
"Nah, I was helpin' these folks find somebody.{w}Right?"{w}{p}"Sorry, nope,{w}ain't seen anybody with a robe over their head,{w}ain't seen any weirdo like that, nope."{w}
note: Zonette fakes a conversation with the party to fool Molder; the robed person is invented (Molder later learns it was a lie).

en: "Oh, perfect timing!{w}Why, here's the honorable Captain of the Guard!"{w}{p}"Try askin' this one here!{w}Well, I got stuff to do, so later!"{w}
note: Koitsu = Molder; 'this one' avoids a gendered 'guy' (Molder's gender is unknown in the glossary). Keibiheichou = Captain of the Guard.

en:
"Zonette, what stuff? Hey, wait!{w}Ah... you there,{w}just to be sure, you're looking for someone?"{w}{p}"...No?{w}Damn it, fooled again!
ZONETTE!!"{w}
"Mmf, nom... mm, this is good.{w}
note: Zonette is eating the stall food Molder accuses her of stealing in row 1311.

en:
{0E}"Mmf, nom... mm, this is good.{0F}
Yo! We meet again."{w}
"...Oh!{w}You can have the rest! Don't leave any, got it?{w}See ya!!"{w}
note: Zonette spots Molder coming and dumps the stolen food on the party.

en: "Huff... huff... Oh, you there,{w}have you seen someone named Zonette!?{w}That thief swiped goods from a stall!"{w}{p}"If you see Zonette, tell me!{w}ZONETTE! Where'd you go!?"{w}
note: 'That thief' and the repeated name avoid a pronoun for Zonette (gender unknown).

en: "Yo! You guys dropped your wallet, right?{w}Say it again: you dropped it, right!{w}
note: Zonette is pressuring the party to agree; the wallet was pickpocketed from someone else (row 1315).

en: "Uh-huh, uh-huh. Kind ol' me will give it back to ya."{w}
"Found you, Zonette!{w}I saw you lift that wallet!"{w}

"Now hand it over! Hand it over now! Hand it over this instant!
And then get ready for a lecture!"{w}
"What're you talkin' about?{w}Me? Do a thing like that!?"{w}
"These eyes don't miss a thing!{w}I'm searching your stuff, all right? Good!{w}..........................................."{w}
note: Fushiana ('knotholes for eyes') = unobservant; 'These eyes don't miss a thing' set up so row 1320 can echo it.

en: "You done yet?{w}I got plans after this, y'know.{w}See ya around, Molderrr."{w}
"That can't be... these eyes missed...{w}...What about that wallet?{w}...............What did you say?"{w}
note: Molder finds nothing on Zonette, notices the party holding the wallet and hears where it came from.

en: "...........ZONETTEEEEEEE!!!"{w}
"Huh? Got somethin' nice there, don'tcha?{w}Lookin' pretty flush.{w}Truth is, I dropped my money and I'm in a real fix."{w}
"Lend me 1,000 GP. 'Kay?"
note: Choice prompt (data row).

en: "Thanks a bunch. I'll pay ya back sometime.{w}See ya, you softies!"{w}
note: Ohitoyoshi-domo ('you bunch of soft touches') is Zonette's running name for the party; rendered 'softies' throughout.

en: "None? No way. You're hidin' it, ain'tcha?{w}Jump up and down right there, go on, jump!{w}...Not even a jingle of loose change..."{w}
"...Guess you lot have it rough too, huh.{w}Fine, forget it. Get goin'."{w}
"...You lot, hand over some cash.{w}Yeah, I dropped my wallet.{w}I think. Just now."{w}

note: Choice prompt (data row).

en: "...Huh, coulda squeezed you for more.{w}Oh well."{w}
note: Fukkakeru = ask an inflated price; she realises they paid without haggling.

en: "Thank ya kindly, softies!"{w}

"Hey! You softies over there!
Yeah, you!{w}Lend me some money! I need it right now!"{w}
"I'll pay ya back! Gimme ALL of it!"
note: Choice prompt (data row); 36 chars, prompt rows elsewhere run to 42. 'Sugu' (right away) compressed out of the promise.

en: "...Tch, what the hell.{w}You always handed it over before..."{w}
"Shut up, it's nothin'!{w}Just get lost already!"{w}
You handed all your money over to Zonette.{w}
"...............Right, I'll pay ya back real soon!{w}Wait for me, okay!?{w}

note: Four pages of pure ellipsis (the party waiting); kept as 3 lines of dots per page.

en: "...Whoo, what a haul, what a haul! Wha--{w}
note: Tte = cut-off reaction on spotting the party; rendered as an interrupted 'Wha--'.

en:
{0E}"...Whoo, what a haul, what a haul! Wha--{0F}
Huh!? What, you lot are still here!?{w}...Unbelievable. You shoulda gone home! Are you stupid or what?"{w}
note: Zonette gambled the money and won big (oogachi).

en: "...............Aw, fine, I get it!{w}I only won thanks to you guys anyway!{w}Here! Take it, ya bandits!!"{w}
note: Motteke dorobo = market-stall idiom ('take it, you robber'), kept as 'Take it, ya bandits!!'.

en: Zonette paid you back in full.{w}

"..................Fine, fine, I hear ya!{w}From now on, the only one I'll
mess with is Molder!"{w}
note: Answers an unseen player request to stop messing with people.

en: "But listen up, softies,{w}lemme give ya one bit of advice."{w}{p}"Instead of somebody obvious like me,{w}watch out for the more ordinary types."{w}{p}"The ones puttin' on a good, harmless face,{w}they're the nastiest of the lot. Got it?{w}
"Honestly..."{w}
"Yo, softies!{w}Lately I gotta say, I've kinda lost my bite.{w}Maybe some softie's rubbed off on me."{w}
note: Doku-ke ga nukeru = lose one's venom/edge.

en: Arlotte
note: New name (aruro-tte). Data row used as the speaker label.

en: "The finest songstress on the highway,{w}may Arlotte sing a song for you?"{w}
note: Kaidou zuiichi = best along the (trade) highway; Teridon sits on that road.

en: "...No, I suppose I am no longer{w}the finest on the highway."{w}

"A singer ought not to pine for the past,
but..."{w}

"Believe it or not, I was once called the finest on the highway,{w}and every day I sang surrounded
by crowds of patrons."{w}
"But that is a tale from long ago.{w}The strength has left my voice,{w}and the notes that once came so easily..."{w}

"We are living things, after all.{w}I always knew this day would come
sooner or later..."{w}

"A singer should speak only through song;{w}I know it is foolish to speak
any other way, but..."{w}{p}"...Just once more...{w}with a soprano that rings out...!"{w}{p}"Just once more would be enough --{w}I want to sing...!{w}That is what I find myself thinking."{w}{p}"...Forgive me.{w}
note: Source page 2 lacks its closing bracket; a closing quote is added in English. Codes unchanged.

en:
{0E}"...Forgive me.{0F}
Now then, what shall I sing for you today?"{w}

note: Giaf Dunes = GIAFU sakyuu; new name.

en:
"Only if it is on your way.{w}Should you ever head to the Giaf Dunes...{w}might you bring back some of that plant for me?"{w}{p}"I am well aware how shameful it is for a singer{w}to ask such a favor of adventurers
who are among my own patrons..."{w}{p}"...If only I could sing with that voice{w}just once more, I thought.{w}...I humbly ask this of you."{w}
note: Okyakusama no hitori de aru boukensha = the party counts as one of the patrons. Page 2 clause order rearranged across its {w} for English word order; meaning unchanged.
